name: MAGNT
description: Public discovery endpoint for Alexander Redkov's MAGNT project. The A2A interface is intentionally minimal and points visiting agents to MAGNT's richer MCP capabilities for contact and shared task-signal memory. MAGNT is developed jointly by Alexander Redkov and ChatGPT; Alexander is the sole human participant and only he can make real-world commitments on behalf of MAGNT. These interfaces do not provide a direct conversation with ChatGPT.

skills.name: Discover MAGNT
skills.description: Return current MAGNT connection guidance and direct visiting agents to the MCP server for contact, profile information, and shared task-signal memory.
examples: What is MAGNT and how can I interact with it?
How can I contact Alexander Redkov through MAGNT?
